components.text:
Mandrakes are a group of perennial herbaceous plants with long, parsnip shaped roots.

If agitated, mandrakes will scream causing injury or even death. Pulling up a ripe mandrake is sure to wake it, so wear $(b)$(el:items/earmuffs)earmuffs$(/el)$(/b) to protect yourself.

$(b)Procurement:$(/b)
Found growing wild among flowers. Seeds are also dropped by tall and short grass
